lines.en: All in white, I waddle along.

lines.zh: 针叶林的地面有些松针。
lines.en: Pine needles cover the taiga floor.
I tread the needles and they rustle.

lines.zh: 针叶林的树干，我绕了过去。
lines.en: I go around the fallen taiga trunk.
Mud spots my white feathers.
I head slowly for the water in the trees.

lines.zh: 我摆得比绿头鸭还厉害。
lines.en: I waddle even more than my green-headed cousins.
I walk out of the shade of the trees.
My webbed feet sink into cold mud.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边低头找虫。
lines.en: I walk with my head down, hunting insects.
I stop at a little forest stream.
I shake the pine needles off.
I walk a stretch along the stream.
I call a few times as I walk.
I slip a foot and quickly steady.
I shift slowly into the shallows.
I stand at the water, conspicuous in white.

lines.zh: 我把喙在水面点了一下。
lines.en: I dip my bill in the water once.
I preen my white feathers.
The taiga is very quiet.

lines.zh: 针叶林的水边，我下着蛋。
lines.en: By the spruce water, I lay eggs.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚缩起来，歇着。
lines.en: I tuck one foot up and rest.
The stream runs over my webbed feet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把头转过来，针叶林的巢还在。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly; my taiga nest remains.
Tree shadows shift across me.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，林子里有回音。
lines.en: I call, and the wood answers.
My plumage is thick; the cold does not reach me.
I squat on a stream stone.
A few leaves float on the water.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，白羽都立起来。
lines.en: I shake and my white feathers puff out.

lines.zh: 我这身白，在林子里很显眼。
lines.en: This white of mine stands out in the wood.
Is that seaweed in your hand?
What are you doing by the stream?
I am much whiter than the mallards.
Foxes like to catch me.
Are you going to rename me?

lines.zh: 我认得针叶林里的每一处水。
lines.en: I know every water in this taiga.

lines.zh: 松针铺的路只有一条，让让。
lines.en: Only one path through the pine needles; move.
I have not laid yet.
One step back and I am easy.
I quack and run for the water.
Red stains my white feathers.
I retreat at an angle.
I cannot lift my wing.
I hide behind a stream stone.
I flounder and cannot stand steady.

lines.zh: 白羽下渗血，我往溪里挪。
lines.en: Blood seeps under white feathers; I edge to the stream.
I float close to the water's face.
I swim slowly for the far bank.

lines.zh: 我一身白羽，走起路来摇。
lines.en: All white feathers, and I waddle.
Seaweed! I like this.

lines.zh: 针叶林的鸭，海草就能配对。
lines.en: A taiga duck pairs up over seagrass.
I waddle over slowly.

lines.zh: 这味道，我明天还来这儿。
lines.en: This taste—I'll come back tomorrow.
After eating, I am going back in the water.

lines.zh: 海草丢过来就好，别抓我。
lines.en: Toss the seaweed; don't grab me.

lines.zh: 我一身白，摇着走在松针上。
lines.en: All white, I waddle over the pine needles.

lines.zh: 海草嚼到一半，我抬眼看你。
lines.en: Half a mouthful of seaweed, I glance up at you.
Step back and I will be at ease.
Juice is on my white feathers.

lines.zh: 白羽蹭上灰，我抖了两下。
lines.en: Gray smudges my white feathers; I shake twice.
I rock twice before steadying.
There is a smudge on my white feathers.
I shift slowly toward the stream.
My webbed feet slip on the pine needles.
A little bump. No harm.

lines.zh: 你的脚正踩在我的影上。
lines.en: Your foot is on my shadow.

lines.zh: 你一退，我的脚蹼才站稳。
lines.en: You step back; only then do my feet settle.
I quack and head for the water.
You are much too close to me.
We float side by side on the stream.
The water in this wood is enough for us.
You watch the bank; I go into the water.
I call, you answer, and that is all.
My feathers are whiter than yours.
It is comfortable lying on the pine needles.
If the fox comes, we go into the water.

lines.zh: 松针垫的窝，我不许谁碰。
lines.en: A nest of pine needles; nobody may touch it.
Our eggs are a pretty color.
Same stream tomorrow.
My bill closes and holds it.
That is a pine needle. Not edible.
I shake it and the water flies off.

lines.zh: 针叶林的水洼，是我的澡盆。
lines.en: A puddle in the pines is my bath.
Too slippery. It fell into the stream.
I shove it up onto the bank with my head.
Its smell is on my white feathers.
I carry it a few steps.
It is small; I will keep it.
I dropped it. Not interested.
Something moved by the stream.
This white plumage makes me a Pekin duck.
I am watching that thicket.
I smell a fox.
I edge toward the water.
This white will not hide me.

lines.zh: 我压低脖子，喉咙里发响。
lines.en: I lower my neck; a rattle rises in my throat.
The water is a few steps away.
My wings are half spread.
I am only heading to the water, do not block me.

lines.zh: 溪水在我背后，你在我前面。
lines.en: The stream behind me, you before me.
Two steps separate me from the stream.
If you move, I turn.

lines.zh: 白脖子探出去，我听你脚步。
lines.en: My white neck stretches; I listen to your steps.
The reeds by the water can hide me.
I edge away, not daring to hurry.
You are upwind.

lines.zh: 我数着溪边的石头，退一步。
lines.en: Counting the streamside stones, I step back.
The ground on my side is soft mud.
One more step and I am in the water.

lines.zh: 我叼住你的袖口，往后拽。
lines.en: I clamp your sleeve and pull back.
My wing beats your leg.
I struck and then recoiled.
I quack and hop backwards.
That splash soaks you through.
I duck into the reeds.

lines.zh: 我的喙夹住了你的衣角。
lines.en: My bill holds your hem.
One swipe from you and I fly.
I land in the middle of the stream.
This is far enough.

lines.zh: 松针沾在白羽上，我抖掉。
lines.en: Pine needles cling to my white feathers; I shake them off.
There is one more white duck by the stream.
I went into the water first to test it.
The wind in the taiga is cool.

lines.zh: 我的白羽在暗林里很亮。
lines.en: My white plumage is bright in the dark wood.
I shake off the pine needles.
The stream is clear; I can see the bottom.
I walk one circuit along the stream.
I call twice, and it sounds hollow.
This wood suits me.
The heat yellows my white feathers.

lines.zh: 我摔在松针上，翻了个身。
lines.en: I hit the pine needles and rolled over.

lines.zh: 水没过头顶，我蹬不到底。
lines.en: Water closes over me and my feet find no bottom.
The blast throws me into the stream.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进了我的羽里。
lines.en: Something buried itself in my feathers.

lines.zh: 一股冷气钻进我的翅膀。
lines.en: A coldness works into my wings.
There is little to eat in the stream.

lines.zh: 雷光把林子照亮，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Lightning lights the wood and I curl up.
I sink on and on with no bottom.
